meta.series: DSA for Freshers: Mid-level Company Roadmap
meta.level_title: Foundation: Arrays, Hashing, Strings, Math, Recursion
meta.note: company_tags indicative hain (frequently asked trends), official guarantee nahi.

theory.concept: Complexity batata hai ki input size n badhne par tumhara code kitna slow hoga ya kitni memory lega. Interview me pehle brute force bolo, phir complexity se bottleneck dikhao, phir optimize karo.
key_points: Common order: O(1) < O(log n) < O(n) < O(n log n) < O(n^2) < O(2^n)
Constraints se andaza lagao: n<=1e5 => O(n log n) chalega; n<=1e3 => O(n^2); n<=20 => O(2^n)
Roughly 1e8 simple operations/second maan lo C++ me
Space me extra memory count hoti hai (input array count nahi hota, par recursion stack hota hai)
pitfalls: Nested loop hamesha O(n^2) nahi hota (inner loop chhota ho sakta hai)
Hash map ko O(1) bolte hain par worst case O(n) hota hai
Recursion stack depth ko space me bhoolna

theory.concept: Array contiguous memory me same type ke elements store karta hai. Index se access O(1), par middle me insert/delete O(n) kyunki shifting hoti hai.
key_points: Traversal, prefix/suffix thinking aur in-place modification basic skills hain
In-place trick: ek pointer read ke liye, doosra write ke liye (overwrite pattern)
Reverse 3 times se rotation ho jata hai
XOR trick: a^a=0, a^0=a, isse pairs cancel ho jaate hain
vector<int> me size() unsigned hota hai, i-1 karte waqt careful
pitfalls: Empty array / single element edge case
k > n rotation me k%=n bhoolna
Sum me int overflow, long long use karo

theory.concept: String characters ka sequence hai. C++ me std::string mutable hai. Zyadatar problems me frequency count, two pointers ya in-place reverse use hota hai.
key_points: Lowercase letters ke liye int freq[26], ASCII ke liye freq[256]
Two pointers (left, right) se palindrome/reverse O(n) me
isalnum(), tolower() <cctype> me milte hain
s += c amortized O(1); par s = s + c O(n) hota hai
pitfalls: char ko unsigned char cast karke index banana (negative index bug)

theory.concept: Hashing se key ko seedha index me map karte hain, isliye lookup/insert average O(1). 'Pehle dekha hai kya?' wale sawaal ka best tool.
key_points: unordered_map / unordered_set: average O(1), unordered; map / set: O(log n), sorted
Pattern: complement dhundo (target - x), frequency count, seen-before check
Small fixed range (26 letters / 0..n) ho to array hash map se tez aur simple
Trade-off: time kam karne ke liye O(n) extra space kharch karte hain
pitfalls: Map me insert karne se pehle check karo (Two Sum me same element dobara use na ho)
operator[] missing key ko default insert kar deta hai
Anti-hash tests par worst case O(n)

theory.concept: GCD, primes, sieve, fast power aur digit manipulation sabse zyada poochhe jaane wale math basics hain.
key_points: Euclid: gcd(a,b)=gcd(b, a%b), O(log min(a,b))
Prime check sirf sqrt(n) tak; Sieve of Eratosthenes O(n log log n)
Binary exponentiation: x^n ko O(log n) me (n ko bits me tod do)
Digit pop: d = x%10; x /= 10
Overflow check INT_MAX se pehle karo, baad me nahi
pitfalls: INT_MIN ko negate karna overflow hai, long long lo
Sieve me j ko i*i se start karo

theory.concept: Function khud ko chhote subproblem par call karta hai. Har recursion me 1) base case 2) recursive case hona chahiye. Calls call stack par rehti hain.
key_points: Pehle base case likho, phir chhota problem define karo
Fibonacci naive recursion O(2^n) hai kyunki same subproblems baar baar solve hote hain
Overlapping subproblems => memoization / DP (Level 5 me detail)
Divide & conquer jaise fast power me problem half ho jata hai
Recursion depth ~1e5 se upar stack overflow de sakta hai
pitfalls: Space complexity me stack depth count karna

problems.title: Largest Element in Array
problems.problem_statement: Given an array of integers, return the largest element.
problems.description: Array ke saare elements me se maximum value dhundni hai.
problems.theory: Linear scan: ek variable me ab tak ka max rakho aur har element se compare karo.

brute_force.approach: Array sort karo aur last element lo.
brute_force.code_cpp: int largest(vector<int> a){ sort(a.begin(), a.end()); return a.back(); }

optimized.approach: Pehle element se start karke ek pass me max update karo.
optimized.code_cpp: int largest(const vector<int>& a){ int mx = a[0]; for(int x : a) mx = max(mx, x); return mx; }

problems.explanation: Sorting zaroorat se zyada kaam hai. Sirf max chahiye to ek pass kaafi hai. mx ko INT_MIN ya a[0] se init karo.

problems.title: Second Largest Distinct Element
problems.problem_statement: Return the second largest distinct element of the array, or -1 if it does not exist.
problems.description: Largest ke baad wala alag (distinct) value chahiye. Agar saare equal hain to -1.
problems.theory: Ek pass me do variables maintain karo: first aur second. Update order important hai.

brute_force.approach: Descending sort karo, phir first se alag pehla element return karo.
brute_force.code_cpp: int secondLargest(vector<int> a){ sort(a.rbegin(), a.rend()); for(int i = 1; i < (int)a.size(); i++) if(a[i] != a[0]) return a[i]; return -1; }

optimized.approach: Ek pass: x > first to second = first, first = x; warna x < first aur x > second to second = x.
optimized.code_cpp: int secondLargest(const vector<int>& a){ long long f = LLONG_MIN, s = LLONG_MIN; for(int x : a){ if(x > f){ s = f; f = x; } else if(x < f && x > s) s = x; } return s == LLONG_MIN ? -1 : (int)s; }

problems.explanation: x == first hone par kuch update nahi karte, isse distinct maintain hota hai. long long sentinel INT_MIN wali value se clash nahi karta.

problems.title: Check if Array is Sorted
problems.problem_statement: Return true if the array is sorted in non-decreasing order.
problems.description: Har adjacent pair ke liye a[i-1] <= a[i] hona chahiye.
problems.theory: Local condition (adjacent pairs) poore array ki sortedness guarantee deti hai.

brute_force.approach: Array ki copy sort karo aur original se compare karo.
brute_force.code_cpp: bool isSorted(vector<int> a){ vector<int> b = a; sort(b.begin(), b.end()); return a == b; }

optimized.approach: Ek pass me pehla violation milte hi false return karo.
optimized.code_cpp: bool isSorted(const vector<int>& a){ for(size_t i = 1; i < a.size(); i++) if(a[i] < a[i-1]) return false; return true; }

problems.explanation: Transitivity: agar har adjacent pair theek hai to poora array sorted hai. Early exit se average case aur tez.

problems.title: Remove Duplicates from Sorted Array (In-place)
problems.problem_statement: Given a sorted array, remove duplicates in-place so each value appears once. Return the new length k; first k elements must hold the unique values.
problems.description: Extra array allowed nahi hai (O(1) space). Sorted hone ki wajah se duplicates adjacent hote hain.
problems.theory: Two pointer (slow/fast): slow last unique ki position hai, fast scan karta hai.

brute_force.approach: Set me daalo (auto-unique + sorted), phir wapas array me copy karo.
brute_force.code_cpp: int removeDuplicates(vector<int>& a){ set<int> s(a.begin(), a.end()); int i = 0; for(int x : s) a[i++] = x; return i; }

optimized.approach: i = last unique index; j scan kare. a[j] != a[i] ho to a[++i] = a[j].
optimized.code_cpp: int removeDuplicates(vector<int>& a){ if(a.empty()) return 0; int i = 0; for(int j = 1; j < (int)a.size(); j++) if(a[j] != a[i]) a[++i] = a[j]; return i + 1; }

problems.explanation: Sorted property ka fayda: duplicate hamesha last unique se compare karke pakad lete hain. Ye pattern Level 2 ke Two Pointers ki base hai.

problems.title: Move Zeroes to End
problems.problem_statement: Move all 0s to the end while keeping the relative order of non-zero elements. Do it in-place.
problems.description: Non-zero elements ka order same rehna chahiye (stable).
problems.theory: Two pointers: j = next non-zero ke liye jagah. Non-zero mile to swap(a[i], a[j++]).

brute_force.approach: Non-zero ko temp vector me copy karo, baaki zeros se bharo, wapas copy.
brute_force.code_cpp: void moveZeroes(vector<int>& a){ vector<int> t; for(int x : a) if(x != 0) t.push_back(x); while(t.size() < a.size()) t.push_back(0); a = t; }

optimized.approach: j write position; i scan; a[i] != 0 par swap(a[i], a[j++]).
optimized.code_cpp: void moveZeroes(vector<int>& a){ int j = 0; for(int i = 0; i < (int)a.size(); i++) if(a[i] != 0) swap(a[i], a[j++]); }

problems.explanation: Invariant: [0, j) me saare non-zero hain aur [j, i) me saare zero. Swap invariant bachata hai.

problems.title: Rotate Array by K (Right)
problems.problem_statement: Rotate the array to the right by k steps, in-place.
problems.description: Har step me last element aage aata hai. k, n se bada ho sakta hai.
problems.theory: Reversal algorithm: poora reverse, phir pehle k, phir baaki n-k reverse karo. k %= n zaroori.

brute_force.approach: Ek step rotation k baar karo (last ko pakdo, sabko shift karo).
brute_force.code_cpp: void rotateArr(vector<int>& a, int k){ int n = a.size(); k %= n; while(k--){ int last = a.back(); for(int i = n-1; i > 0; i--) a[i] = a[i-1]; a[0] = last; } }

optimized.approach: k %= n; reverse(all); reverse(0..k); reverse(k..n).
optimized.code_cpp: void rotateArr(vector<int>& a, int k){ int n = a.size(); k %= n; reverse(a.begin(), a.end()); reverse(a.begin(), a.begin() + k); reverse(a.begin() + k, a.end()); }

problems.explanation: Reverse karne se last k elements aage aa jaate hain par ulte order me; dobara reverse se order seedha ho jata hai.

problems.title: Missing Number
problems.problem_statement: Array of n distinct numbers in range [0, n]. Return the one number missing from the range.
problems.description: Range n+1 numbers ki hai par array me n hain, to exactly ek missing hai.
problems.theory: XOR trick: index 0..n aur array values sab XOR karo; pairs cancel hote hain, missing bach jata hai. Sum formula bhi chalta hai.

brute_force.approach: 0 se n tak har number ke liye array me linear search karo.
brute_force.code_cpp: int missingNumber(const vector<int>& a){ int n = a.size(); for(int x = 0; x <= n; x++){ bool f = false; for(int v : a) if(v == x){ f = true; break; } if(!f) return x; } return -1; }

optimized.approach: x = n; har i par x ^= i ^ a[i]. Final x answer.
optimized.code_cpp: int missingNumber(const vector<int>& a){ int x = a.size(); for(int i = 0; i < (int)a.size(); i++) x ^= i ^ a[i]; return x; }

problems.explanation: a^a = 0 aur a^0 = a. Present numbers do baar aate hain (ek index se, ek value se) to cancel; missing sirf ek baar aata hai.

problems.title: Max Consecutive Ones
problems.problem_statement: Given a binary array, return the maximum number of consecutive 1s.
problems.description: Continuous 1s ka sabse lamba run chahiye.
problems.theory: Running counter: 1 mile to cnt++, 0 mile to cnt = 0; best update karte raho.

brute_force.approach: Har start index se tab tak count karo jab tak 1 mile.
brute_force.code_cpp: int maxOnes(const vector<int>& a){ int best = 0, n = a.size(); for(int i = 0; i < n; i++){ int c = 0; for(int j = i; j < n && a[j] == 1; j++) c++; best = max(best, c); } return best; }

optimized.approach: Single pass counter reset on 0.
optimized.code_cpp: int maxOnes(const vector<int>& a){ int best = 0, c = 0; for(int x : a){ c = x ? c + 1 : 0; best = max(best, c); } return best; }

problems.explanation: Brute me har run baar baar re-scan hota hai. Single pass me har element sirf ek baar dekha jata hai.

problems.title: Single Number (Every Other Appears Twice)
problems.problem_statement: Every element appears twice except one. Find that single one using O(1) extra space.
problems.description: Linear time aur constant space me answer chahiye.
problems.theory: XOR properties: commutative, associative, a^a=0, a^0=a. Saare XOR karo to pairs cancel.

brute_force.approach: HashMap me frequency count karo, jiska count 1 ho wo answer.
brute_force.code_cpp: int single(const vector<int>& a){ unordered_map<int,int> m; for(int x : a) m[x]++; for(auto& p : m) if(p.second == 1) return p.first; return -1; }

optimized.approach: Saare elements ka XOR.
optimized.code_cpp: int single(const vector<int>& a){ int x = 0; for(int v : a) x ^= v; return x; }

problems.explanation: Order matter nahi karta kyunki XOR commutative hai. Bit manipulation ka sabse famous introduction.

problems.title: Two Sum
problems.problem_statement: Return indices of two numbers whose sum equals target. Exactly one solution exists; same element cannot be used twice.
problems.description: Array unsorted hai. Indices return karne hain, values nahi.
problems.theory: Complement idea: x ke liye target - x pehle dekha hai ya nahi. HashMap value -> index.

brute_force.approach: Saare pairs (i, j) check karo.
brute_force.code_cpp: vector<int> twoSum(vector<int>& a, int t){ for(int i = 0; i < (int)a.size(); i++) for(int j = i + 1; j < (int)a.size(); j++) if(a[i] + a[j] == t) return {i, j}; return {}; }

optimized.approach: Ek pass me map me check karo, phir current insert karo.
optimized.code_cpp: vector<int> twoSum(vector<int>& a, int t){ unordered_map<int,int> m; for(int i = 0; i < (int)a.size(); i++){ auto it = m.find(t - a[i]); if(it != m.end()) return {it->second, i}; m[a[i]] = i; } return {}; }

problems.explanation: Insert baad me karte hain, isliye same element dobara use nahi hota. Space se time kharidna: O(n^2) -> O(n).

problems.title: Contains Duplicate
problems.problem_statement: Return true if any value appears at least twice.
problems.description: Koi bhi value repeat hui to true.
problems.theory: Set me pehle se present hai ya nahi check karo (seen-before pattern).

brute_force.approach: Har pair compare karo.
brute_force.code_cpp: bool hasDup(const vector<int>& a){ for(size_t i = 0; i < a.size(); i++) for(size_t j = i + 1; j < a.size(); j++) if(a[i] == a[j]) return true; return false; }

optimized.approach: unordered_set me insert; agar already present to true.
optimized.code_cpp: bool hasDup(const vector<int>& a){ unordered_set<int> s; for(int x : a) if(!s.insert(x).second) return true; return false; }

problems.explanation: insert().second false return karta hai jab element pehle se ho. Alternative: sort karke adjacent compare, O(n log n) time O(1) space.

problems.title: Valid Anagram
problems.problem_statement: Given strings s and t, return true if t is an anagram of s.
problems.description: Same letters same frequency me, order alag ho sakta hai.
problems.theory: Frequency array of size 26: s ke liye ++, t ke liye --, end me sab 0 hona chahiye.

brute_force.approach: Dono strings sort karo aur compare karo.
brute_force.code_cpp: bool isAnagram(string s, string t){ sort(s.begin(), s.end()); sort(t.begin(), t.end()); return s == t; }

optimized.approach: Length check, phir freq[26] se increment/decrement.
optimized.code_cpp: bool isAnagram(const string& s, const string& t){ if(s.size() != t.size()) return false; int f[26] = {0}; for(size_t i = 0; i < s.size(); i++){ f[s[i]-'a']++; f[t[i]-'a']--; } for(int c : f) if(c) return false; return true; }

problems.explanation: 26 size ka array hash map ka chhota fast version hai. Unicode input ho to unordered_map use karo.

problems.title: First Non-Repeating Character
problems.problem_statement: Return the index of the first non-repeating character in the string, or -1.
problems.description: Pehla character jo poori string me sirf ek baar aaya ho.
problems.theory: Do-pass hashing: pehle frequency, phir string dobara scan karke pehla freq==1.

brute_force.approach: Har character ke liye poori string me count karo.
brute_force.code_cpp: int firstUniq(const string& s){ for(int i = 0; i < (int)s.size(); i++){ int c = 0; for(char ch : s) if(ch == s[i]) c++; if(c == 1) return i; } return -1; }

optimized.approach: freq[26] banao, phir left to right pehla freq 1 return.
optimized.code_cpp: int firstUniq(const string& s){ int f[26] = {0}; for(char c : s) f[c-'a']++; for(int i = 0; i < (int)s.size(); i++) if(f[s[i]-'a'] == 1) return i; return -1; }

problems.explanation: Frequency pehle poori string se nikalni padti hai kyunki aage ke characters bhi count ko badal sakte hain.

problems.title: Majority Element (> n/2)
problems.problem_statement: Return the element that appears more than n/2 times. It always exists.
problems.description: Guarantee hai ki majority element exist karta hai.
problems.theory: Boyer-Moore Voting: candidate aur count rakho; same mila to ++, alag mila to --, 0 par naya candidate. Majority sabko cancel karke bhi bach jata hai.

brute_force.approach: HashMap me frequency count karo, jiska count > n/2 ho return.
brute_force.code_cpp: int majority(const vector<int>& a){ unordered_map<int,int> m; for(int x : a) if(++m[x] > (int)a.size()/2) return x; return -1; }

optimized.approach: Boyer-Moore Voting Algorithm.
optimized.code_cpp: int majority(const vector<int>& a){ int cand = 0, cnt = 0; for(int x : a){ if(cnt == 0) cand = x; cnt += (x == cand) ? 1 : -1; } return cand; }

problems.explanation: Majority element ke paas n/2 se zyada votes hain, to baaki saare milke bhi usse cancel nahi kar sakte.

problems.title: Intersection of Two Arrays (Unique)
problems.problem_statement: Return the unique elements that appear in both arrays, in any order.
problems.description: Result me duplicates nahi hone chahiye.
problems.theory: Ek array ko set me daalo aur doosre ke elements ko usme lookup karo. Used-set se duplicates hatao.

brute_force.approach: Har a[i] ko har b[j] se compare karo.
brute_force.code_cpp: vector<int> intersect(const vector<int>& a, const vector<int>& b){ vector<int> r; for(int x : a){ bool inB = false; for(int y : b) if(x == y){ inB = true; break; } bool dup = find(r.begin(), r.end(), x) != r.end(); if(inB && !dup) r.push_back(x); } return r; }

optimized.approach: Set A banao, B scan karo; mile to result me daalo aur A se erase kar do (dobara na aaye).
optimized.code_cpp: vector<int> intersect(const vector<int>& a, const vector<int>& b){ unordered_set<int> s(a.begin(), a.end()); vector<int> r; for(int y : b) if(s.count(y)){ r.push_back(y); s.erase(y); } return r; }

problems.explanation: Erase karna ek neat trick hai duplicates hatane ka bina extra set ke.

problems.title: Reverse a String (In-place)
problems.problem_statement: Reverse the given character array in-place using O(1) extra memory.
problems.description: Naya string banana allowed nahi (in-place).
problems.theory: Two pointers left/right ko center ki taraf le jao aur swap karo.

brute_force.approach: Naya string banao jisme end se start tak characters push karo.
brute_force.code_cpp: string rev(const string& s){ string r; for(int i = (int)s.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) r += s[i]; return r; }

optimized.approach: l = 0, r = n-1; while l < r: swap(s[l++], s[r--]).
optimized.code_cpp: void rev(string& s){ int l = 0, r = (int)s.size() - 1; while(l < r) swap(s[l++], s[r--]); }

problems.explanation: Sirf n/2 swaps lagte hain. Ye two-pointer ka sabse basic form hai.

problems.title: Valid Palindrome (Alphanumeric)
problems.problem_statement: Return true if the string is a palindrome after ignoring non-alphanumeric characters and case.
problems.description: Spaces aur punctuation ignore karo, uppercase/lowercase same maano.

test_cases.input: A man, a plan, a canal: Panama

problems.theory: Two pointers: invalid characters skip karo, phir tolower karke compare.

brute_force.approach: Cleaned string banao, uska reverse banao aur compare karo.
brute_force.code_cpp: bool isPal(const string& s){ string t; for(char c : s) if(isalnum((unsigned char)c)) t += tolower(c); string r(t.rbegin(), t.rend()); return t == r; }

optimized.approach: l, r pointers; non-alnum skip; mismatch par false.
optimized.code_cpp: bool isPal(const string& s){ int l = 0, r = (int)s.size() - 1; while(l < r){ while(l < r && !isalnum((unsigned char)s[l])) l++; while(l < r && !isalnum((unsigned char)s[r])) r--; if(tolower(s[l]) != tolower(s[r])) return false; l++; r--; } return true; }

problems.explanation: Extra string ki jagah pointers se O(1) space. unsigned char cast negative char par undefined behavior se bachata hai.

problems.title: Longest Common Prefix
problems.problem_statement: Find the longest common prefix among an array of strings. Return empty string if none.
problems.description: Saare strings ke shuru ka common hissa.
problems.theory: Vertical scanning: column by column check karo, mismatch par ruk jao.

brute_force.approach: Pehli string ke prefixes lambe se chhote try karo aur har ek ko sab strings me check karo.
brute_force.code_cpp: string lcp(const vector<string>& v){ string f = v[0]; for(int len = f.size(); len > 0; len--){ string p = f.substr(0, len); bool ok = true; for(auto& s : v) if(s.compare(0, len, p) != 0){ ok = false; break; } if(ok) return p; } return ""; }

optimized.approach: Column i par har string ka character v[0][i] se compare karo; mismatch ya end par prefix return.
optimized.code_cpp: string lcp(const vector<string>& v){ for(size_t i = 0; i < v[0].size(); i++) for(size_t j = 1; j < v.size(); j++) if(i >= v[j].size() || v[j][i] != v[0][i]) return v[0].substr(0, i); return v[0]; }

problems.explanation: Brute me substr aur compare repeat hote hain. Vertical scan me jaise hi mismatch mila, kaam khatam.

problems.title: Reverse Words in a String
problems.problem_statement: Reverse the order of words. Remove leading, trailing and extra spaces; words separated by a single space in the output.
problems.description: Words ka order ulta karna hai (words ke andar ke characters nahi).
problems.theory: Trick: pura string reverse karo, phir har word ko individually reverse karo, spaces compress karte hue.

brute_force.approach: stringstream se words nikalo, vector reverse karo, join karo.
brute_force.code_cpp: string revWords(const string& s){ stringstream ss(s); string w; vector<string> v; while(ss >> w) v.push_back(w); string r; for(int i = (int)v.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--){ r += v[i]; if(i) r += ' '; } return r; }

optimized.approach: Pura reverse; phir har word ko write pointer idx par copy karke segment reverse; end me resize(idx).
optimized.code_cpp: string revWords(string s){ reverse(s.begin(), s.end()); int n = s.size(), idx = 0; for(int i = 0; i < n; i++){ if(s[i] != ' '){ if(idx) s[idx++] = ' '; int j = i; while(j < n && s[j] != ' ') s[idx++] = s[j++]; reverse(s.begin() + idx - (j - i), s.begin() + idx); i = j; } } s.resize(idx); return s; }

problems.explanation: Pehle reverse se words ka order ulta hota hai (par words ulte). Dobara word-wise reverse se unke andar ka order theek.

problems.title: Isomorphic Strings
problems.problem_statement: Two strings are isomorphic if characters in s can be replaced to get t, with one-to-one mapping and preserved order.
problems.description: Ek character sirf ek hi character se map ho sakta hai aur do alag characters same se map nahi ho sakte.
problems.theory: Do arrays rakho: s->t aur t->s ka last-seen position. Dono ka position same hona chahiye.

brute_force.approach: Har pair (i, j) ke liye (s[i]==s[j]) aur (t[i]==t[j]) same hone chahiye.
brute_force.code_cpp: bool isIso(const string& s, const string& t){ if(s.size() != t.size()) return false; for(size_t i = 0; i < s.size(); i++) for(size_t j = i + 1; j < s.size(); j++) if((s[i] == s[j]) != (t[i] == t[j])) return false; return true; }

optimized.approach: Do arrays a[256], b[256]; a[s[i]] != b[t[i]] to false; warna dono = i+1.
optimized.code_cpp: bool isIso(const string& s, const string& t){ if(s.size() != t.size()) return false; int a[256] = {0}, b[256] = {0}; for(size_t i = 0; i < s.size(); i++){ unsigned char x = s[i], y = t[i]; if(a[x] != b[y]) return false; a[x] = b[y] = i + 1; } return true; }

problems.explanation: i+1 isliye kyunki 0 ka matlab 'abhi dekha nahi'. Dono directions check hone se one-to-one guarantee hoti hai.

problems.title: GCD of Two Numbers
problems.problem_statement: Return the greatest common divisor of two positive integers.
problems.description: Sabse bada number jo dono ko exactly divide kare.
problems.theory: Euclidean algorithm: gcd(a, b) = gcd(b, a % b); jab b == 0 ho to a answer.

brute_force.approach: min(a,b) se 1 tak loop chalao aur pehla common divisor return karo.
brute_force.code_cpp: int gcdBrute(int a, int b){ for(int d = min(a, b); d >= 1; d--) if(a % d == 0 && b % d == 0) return d; return 1; }

optimized.approach: Euclid ka iterative ya recursive version.
optimized.code_cpp: int gcdOpt(int a, int b){ while(b){ int t = a % b; a = b; b = t; } return a; }

problems.explanation: gcd(a,b) = gcd(b, a%b) isliye sahi hai kyunki a aur a%b ka common divisor wahi hota hai jo a aur b ka hota hai. LCM = a / gcd * b.

problems.title: Count Primes less than n
problems.problem_statement: Return the number of primes strictly less than n.
problems.description: n tak ke primes ginne hain, har number ko alag check karna slow hoga.
problems.theory: Sieve of Eratosthenes: prime ke multiples ko composite mark karo, i*i se start karke.

brute_force.approach: Har number ke liye sqrt tak trial division.
brute_force.code_cpp: int countPrimes(int n){ int c = 0; for(int x = 2; x < n; x++){ bool p = true; for(long long d = 2; d * d <= x; d++) if(x % d == 0){ p = false; break; } if(p) c++; } return c; }

optimized.approach: Boolean sieve array; i from 2 to sqrt(n); j = i*i; j < n; j += i mark false.
optimized.code_cpp: int countPrimes(int n){ if(n < 3) return 0; vector<bool> p(n, true); p[0] = p[1] = false; for(long long i = 2; i * i < n; i++) if(p[i]) for(long long j = i * i; j < n; j += i) p[j] = false; return count(p.begin(), p.end(), true); }

problems.explanation: j = i*i se start karte hain kyunki chhote multiples pehle hi chhote primes se mark ho chuke hote hain.

problems.title: Reverse Integer (with Overflow Check)
problems.problem_statement: Reverse the digits of a signed 32-bit integer. If the result overflows the 32-bit range, return 0.
problems.description: Negative number ka sign preserve hona chahiye. 64-bit type ka use nahi karna (interview constraint).
problems.theory: Digit pop/push: d = x % 10; x /= 10; r = r*10 + d. Push se pehle INT_MAX/INT_MIN check karo.

brute_force.approach: String me convert karo, reverse karo, long long me parse karke range check karo.
brute_force.code_cpp: int reverseInt(int x){ long long v = x; bool neg = v < 0; if(neg) v = -v; string s = to_string(v); reverse(s.begin(), s.end()); long long r = stoll(s); if(neg) r = -r; return (r < INT_MIN || r > INT_MAX) ? 0 : (int)r; }

optimized.approach: Digit-by-digit math with pre-overflow check, no extra string.
optimized.code_cpp: int reverseInt(int x){ int r = 0; while(x){ int d = x % 10; x /= 10; if(r > INT_MAX/10 || (r == INT_MAX/10 && d > 7)) return 0; if(r < INT_MIN/10 || (r == INT_MIN/10 && d < -8)) return 0; r = r * 10 + d; } return r; }

problems.explanation: C++ me negative % negative hi deta hai, isliye alag sign handling nahi chahiye. 7 aur -8 INT_MAX (…47) aur INT_MIN (…48) ke last digits hain.

problems.title: Fibonacci Number
problems.problem_statement: Given n, return F(n) where F(0)=0, F(1)=1, F(n)=F(n-1)+F(n-2).
problems.description: Classic recursion + overlapping subproblems ka example.
problems.theory: Naive recursion me same F(k) baar baar compute hota hai (tree O(2^n)). Do variables se iterative O(n) ya memoization.

brute_force.approach: Seedha recursion: F(n) = F(n-1) + F(n-2).
brute_force.code_cpp: int fib(int n){ if(n <= 1) return n; return fib(n - 1) + fib(n - 2); }

optimized.approach: Iterative: prev aur curr do variables roll karte raho.
optimized.code_cpp: int fib(int n){ if(n <= 1) return n; int a = 0, b = 1; for(int i = 2; i <= n; i++){ int c = a + b; a = b; b = c; } return b; }

problems.explanation: n = 40 par naive version bahut slow ho jata hai. Ye DP ka pehla sabak hai: subproblem results store/reuse karo.

problems.title: Pow(x, n) - Fast Exponentiation
problems.problem_statement: Compute x raised to the power n (n can be negative).
problems.description: n bada (1e9 tak) ho sakta hai, isliye O(n) loop TLE de sakta hai.
problems.theory: Binary exponentiation: n ke bits dekho; bit 1 ho to result *= x; har step me x = x*x aur n >>= 1.

brute_force.approach: x ko n baar multiply karo.
brute_force.code_cpp: double myPow(double x, int n){ long long e = n; if(e < 0){ x = 1 / x; e = -e; } double r = 1; for(long long i = 0; i < e; i++) r *= x; return r; }

optimized.approach: Iterative square-and-multiply, n ko long long me convert karo (INT_MIN safe).
optimized.code_cpp: double myPow(double x, int n){ long long e = n; if(e < 0){ x = 1 / x; e = -e; } double r = 1; while(e){ if(e & 1) r *= x; x *= x; e >>= 1; } return r; }

problems.explanation: x^10 = (x^2)^5 -> har bar power aadhi, isliye log n steps. n = INT_MIN par -n int me overflow hota hai isliye long long.
